html:
Vietlook Travel will share with you the top 8 best Ha Long cruises that will bring you relaxing moments, as the boat glides gently through scenic areas through caves, with luxuriously designed boats, from the deck visitors can admire the majestic natural landscape.

Let’s go through the top cruises in Halong through the shares below!

Scarlet Pearl Cruise

Scarlet Pearl meets 5-star standards, is luxuriously designed and can accommodate up to 66 people, including crew and service staff on board.

The cruise is divided into 4 floors, fully equipped with 23 spacious, airy rooms and many types of rooms for visitors to choose from.

The 4 main room categories include:

  • Silver Pearl
  • Golden Pearl
  • Onyx Pearl
  • Scarlet Pearl

All rooms have private balconies and stunning bay views, the designer was inspired by Northern architecture and art when designing the ship, and has Western architecture. In addition, the boat also has restaurants, bars, spas, gyms and exhibition areas.

When choosing a cruise to travel to Ha Long Cat Ba, you will choose the Scarlet Pearl cruise to visit and experience the most interesting things in the bay.

Capella Cruise

The 5-star Capella Halong Cruise is a new experience on Lan Ha Bay. The cruise includes 30 luxurious bedrooms, entertainment rooms and services such as massage, gym, cinema room, poker room, hot tub and swimming pool. All will bring you the best experience during your vacation.

Capella Halong Bay Cruise is a large cruise with classic architectural design in Indochina style, exuding luxury and sophistication, bringing visitors the most comfort.

On the yacht there is a swimming pool and a mini golf course, visitors can relax right on the yacht, and admire the scenery, the yacht includes 30 spacious bedrooms on 5 floors of the yacht equipped with modern and sophisticated amenities, giving visitors unique experiences. The rooms are spacious with full amenities. Each room also has a private balcony area and glass windows for visitors to enjoy the scenery.

Heritage Cruise Binh Chuan

Heritage Cruise meets 5-star cruise standards. When you experience the cruise, you will feel the sophistication in the friendly design.

The cruise is designed luxuriously in Indochinese style, with harmony that will bring visitors the most comfortable moments during their vacation.

The cruise has 4 floors, of which 3 floors are equipped with a system of 20 high-class resort rooms, and there are 4 types of standard rooms, each designed with different sizes.

The cruise has 20 VIP rooms on the 1st and 2nd floors. All have private bathrooms, windows with views of the cruise, and spacious balconies, each room is luxuriously furnished.

Paradise Cruise

As one of the luxury cruises in Ha Long, with 31 rooms, Paradise Elegance Cruise with sophisticated design will bring visitors the most comfort. In addition, visitors can also experience Spa services right on the cruise.
When the boat glides through the scenic area of ​​Tuan Chau and takes you to visit mysterious caves such as: Sung Sot Cave, Thien Cung Cave, Dau Go Cave, Me Cung Cave, Soi Sim Island… will bring you the most perfect cruise tour.

Stellar of the Seas Cruise

Stellar of the Seas is one of the luxury cruise ships, put into operation since 2018. The cruise includes 22 luxurious rooms with full modern equipment and high-class entertainment facilities, including restaurants, open bars, golf courses, four-season swimming pools, wine cellars and spa massage rooms.

Experience the Stellar of the Seas cruise and you will experience outdoor swimming pool services and a golf course right on the cruise.

In addition, when joining the Stellar of the Seas cruise, you can also experience exciting activities such as: squid fishing, cycling, and learning to cook on the boat with professional chefs, With the enthusiastic service of the staff on board will definitely bring you the most enjoyable vacation.

Orchid Classic Cruise

If you want to experience a cruise to explore pristine nature and the most interesting things, the Orchid Classic cruise is the choice for you.

The 5-star cruise, with luxurious amenities that always satisfy even the most demanding guests, will take you through the beautiful landscapes on the bay, or visit Viet Hai village…
The cruise has 14 rooms, and each room has a private balcony, spacious living area, the experience on the cruise will bring you the most enjoyable vacation on Ha Long Bay.

Ambassador Cruises

Ambassador Cruises is one of the luxury cruises in Ha Long that many tourists choose. The cruise has high-class services that bring tourists the most perfect vacation. In addition, when experiencing Ambassador cruise, you can also experience delicious dishes prepared by talented chefs with bold Asian and European flavors.

The cruise will take you to see the beautiful scenery of the bay and explore the world heritage. From the cruise, you can experience kayaking to visit the caves…

La Regina Legend Cruise

La Regina Legend Cruise is uniquely designed to give you the best experience. The cruise has 27 rooms and many different types of rooms. The cruise also has a restaurant with a professional chef, where visitors can enjoy delicious dishes with the rich flavors of the sea.

The cruise will take you to Got Wharf and Ha Long Bay Cat Ba… this is one of the unique and novel journeys that will bring you from one surprise to another, and learn about unique traditional cultural values.

Each room is designed with a private balcony and shower, satisfying every customer with a luxurious design close to nature.

The cruise ship has a mezzanine room. There is a large lobby, a warm reception, and a comfortable waiting area for outdoor activities.

On the cruise there is a luxury restaurant, serving dishes right on the cruise, in addition, visitors can learn to cook right on the cruise with professional chefs, especially dishes prepared according to the needs of visitors.

What Should Be Noted When Booking Halong Cruise Tour?

When booking a Ha Long cruise tour, you need to note the following:

  • Choose a reputable travel agency: Research before booking a tour. Check reviews from previous customers, protection policies, tour cancellation policies and prices.
  • Choose the time and season of the cruise: Ha Long has many different cruise tours, from short-term tours to long-term tours. Choose the right time for your trip and the tourist season you want to visit.
  • Read the tour cancellation policy and conditions carefully before booking a tour.
  • Provide accurate information: When booking a tour, provide complete and accurate information so that the travel agency can contact you if necessary.
  • Prepare suitable clothing for the tour Such as: jackets, sneakers, comfortable clothes for easy movement on the ship and remember to bring a few outfits for virtual life.

We hope that through our sharing in this article, you will have a great Halong cruise tour!
